_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for previs. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: When a plugin edits exterior cells, the previs/precombine advice says "search Nexus for a previs patch", even when the person asking is the mod's own author working on their own mod.
patterns.correction: If the user is the author of the mod, tell them to regenerate precombines and previs for the edited cells themselves (Creation Kit, or a PJM-style xEdit workflow) as a normal release step. Only suggest looking for a third-party previs patch when they're using someone else's mod.
